description: Layout Template catalog for the intake stage (vocabulary: Layout Template, Named Container, Rung, Viewport Ladder). Intake offers a category first (closed list), then the archetype gallery as PLAIN COLORED BOXES with named containers, one default pre-selected per category. The chosen archetype is copied VERBATIM into the answers JSON as layoutTemplate {category, archetype, areas, containers} — intake never composes or edits templates. Plain data; nothing here executes.
areasFormat: CSS grid-template-areas: each array item is one quoted row; area names come from the closed Named Container vocabulary.

feed.label: Feed
feed.summary: One endless stream under an app bar; creation floats on top.

nav-rail.hints: shell switcher; replaces the tab-bar at medium and up

feed.hints: infinite stream of posts or items

fab.hints: compose / create; floats over the feed, not a grid area

sidebar.hints: trends, suggestions, filters; expanded rung only

list-detail.label: List–detail
list-detail.summary: A collection beside the selected item; sequential at compact.

nav-rail.hints: shell switcher at medium and up

detail.hints: the selected item; at compact the panes collapse and detail is a pushed route

supporting-pane.label: Supporting pane
supporting-pane.summary: A main working surface with contextual extras alongside; extras become a sheet below expanded.

nav-rail.hints: shell switcher at medium and up

supporting-pane.hints: comments, attachments, metadata; expanded rung only

sheet.hints: hosts the supporting-pane content below the expanded rung

dashboard.label: Dashboard
dashboard.summary: A toolbar over a grid of metric cards.

nav-rail.hints: shell switcher at medium and up

toolbar.hints: date range, view controls, primary actions over the grid

card-grid.hints: metric cards and charts; reflows per rung

sidebar.hints: alerts, recent activity; expanded rung only

hero-scroll.label: Hero scroll
hero-scroll.summary: A marketing page: hero, then feature blocks, then footer. Single column at every rung; the grid inside card-grid widens.

hero.hints: headline, subhead, primary call to action

card-grid.hints: feature / pricing cards at medium and up

detail-column.label: Detail column
detail-column.summary: One centered detail column — a product, an article — with the primary action floating.

nav-rail.hints: shell switcher at medium and up

detail.hints: the thing itself — gallery, price, description, body

fab.hints: the primary buy / save action; floats over the detail column

sidebar.hints: related items, recommendations; expanded rung only
